author: Bloodoh
body: Do not intentionally take advantage of server exploits that give you an advantage of other players. Doing so may result in a severe punishment, depending on its severity. In many instances we would highly encourage you to submit a ticket on the issue tracker, https://github.com/Avicus/Issues/issues, with details regarding the potential server exploit.
